description: This file defines an API client for a React-based web frontend, providing methods for performing HTTP requests to a backend API, handling mock data when enabled, and offering domain-specific functions like fetching dashboard stats, workouts, members, and plans, as well as assigning plans to members.

methods.name: wrap(promise)
methods.description: Wraps a promise, returning an object with data or error for normalized error handling.

methods.name: request(method, path, body)
methods.description: Performs a fetch request with JSON handling, throwing errors for non-OK responses.

methods.name: apiClient.get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified path.

methods.name: apiClient.post
methods.description: Performs a POST request to the specified path with the given body.

methods.name: apiClient.put
methods.description: Performs a PUT request to the specified path with the given body.

methods.name: apiClient.delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request to the specified path.

methods.name: apiClient.getDashboardStats
methods.description: Fetches dashboard statistics, using mock data if enabled.

methods.name: apiClient.getWorkouts
methods.description: Fetches workouts data, using mock data if enabled.

methods.name: apiClient.addWorkout
methods.description: Adds a new workout, using mock data if enabled.

methods.name: apiClient.getMembers
methods.description: Fetches members data, using mock data if enabled.

methods.name: apiClient.getPlans
methods.description: Fetches plans data, using mock data if enabled.

methods.name: apiClient.assignPlan
methods.description: Assigns a plan to a member.
